headline: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited: Monitoring Agency Report for Q1 FY2026–27
sum: Quarterly monitoring agency report filed under SEBI ICDR Regulations covering IPO proceeds utilization for quarter ended 30 June 2026.
implication: Monitoring agency oversight under Regulation 32(6) of SEBI LODR and Regulation 41(4) of ICDR Regulations mandates quarterly disclosure of IPO fund deployment; this report evidences compliance framework for public capital raises.
detail: The monitoring agency report was filed with NSE pursuant to SEBI's disclosure requirements for IPO-listed companies. The report covers utilization of proceeds from the company's equity IPO during the quarter ended 30 June 2026. SEBI's ICDR Regulations require independent monitoring agency certification of fund deployment against stated prospectus objects.
